report_issue_clusters.observed: The following transitions realise the condition the requirement states as a guard by writing it as the transition label, i.e. as the trigger event: (1) InitialState -> HighwayMode: label `high_way=true`, required guard 'high_way=true' (PlantUML line 9: `InitialState --> HighwayMode : high_way=true`) (2) InitialState -> UrbanMode: label `urban_way=true`, required guard 'urban_way=true' (PlantUML line 10: `InitialState --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true`) (3) lane_change -> cruise: label `lane change complete`, required guard 'lane change is completed' (PlantUML line 24: `lane_change --> cruise : lane change complete`) (4) cruise -> lane_change: label `dist_to_front<25 && extra_lane=true`, required guard 'dist_to_front<25 and extra_lane=true' (PlantUML line 20: `cruise --> lane_change : dist_to_front<25 && extra_lane=true`) (5) enter_urban -> straight: label `road clear`, required guard 'the road ahead is clear' (PlantUML line 33: `enter_urban --> straight : road clear`) (6) enter_urban -> intersection: label `intersection=true`, required guard 'intersection=true' (PlantUML line 34: `enter_urban --> intersection : intersection=true`) (7) lane_change_urban -> straight: label `lane change complete`, required guard 'lane change is complete' (PlantUML line 37: `lane_change_urban --> straight : lane change complete`) (8) straight -> lane_change_urban: label `dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`, required guard 'dist_to_front<15 and extra_lane=true' (PlantUML line 42: `straight --> lane_change_urban : dist_to_front<15 && extra_lane=true`) (9) collision_avoidance_active -> collision_avoidance_deactive: label `front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`, required guard 'front_inactive and rear_inactive and pedestrian_inactive' (PlantUML line 58: `collision_avoidance_active --> collision_avoidance_deactive : front_inactive && rear_inactive && pedestrian_inactive`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger;
